items.title: A cardiac-related, promoter-proximal, regulatory element shapes chromatin and JAG1 transcription.
items.one_liner:
R7 is a promoter‑proximal regulatory element upstream of the JAG1 transcription start site that exhibits enhancer‑like activity and is required for maintaining JAG1 expression in AC16 cardiomyocytes; loss of R7 reduces JAG1 transcription, disrupts local chromatin interactions and accessibility, and impairs cell‑cycle progression, viability, and apoptosis, phenotypes that are partially rescued by restoring JAG1 expression.

METHOD / APPROACH:
Screened ±100 kb around the JAG1 locus with the R‑panel enhancer prediction pipeline, yielding 19 candidate fragments merged into 10 regions (R1‑R10).
